newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Milan to publish March CPI on March 20.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Milan to publish March CPI on March 20.

text.p: The Italian city of Milan will publish its preliminary March consumer price inflation data on Thursday March 20, the city's press office said.
In February, Milan posted a zero month-on-month rise with an annual rate of 2.4 percent, compared to a monthly 0.1 percent rise and 2.4 percent year-on-year rate in February for the whole of Italy.
Milan is one of 11 Italian cities which now publish their inflation data.
Milan's CPI has a weighting of 19.1 percent on the total national index. The official national March CPI inflation data will be published on April 7.
